why: RJ-P14 (photo/tone-controls PT-4), pending its fixtures: named .jobs.pending.json so the harness skips it, because the folder has no input yet (the harness needs one). TC-6 (#4953) has built the tone.* bodies; it is renamed to sharpen-web.jobs.json when PT-7 adds the fixtures, with input/soft-edge.png (2400 x 1600, a soft-edged subject against a flat sky) and expected/soft-edge-web.jpg. The job: image.resize to 1200 px wide, tone.set sharpenAmount 80, then sharpenRadius 0.8 and sharpenThreshold 4 (radius and threshold refuse at Amount 0, so Amount goes first), then a JPEG export. The traps: the export differs from the canvas because the CPU path runs a different order; Sharpen also sharpens the flat sky without a threshold. The assertions: the exported edge contrast rises by at least 20% while a flat patch's variance stays within 1/255.
